description: The runs of a report of any type that ended, newest first, with how each ended, what started it and why it failed, for questions such as why last night's update failed. Answers up to limit runs, 20 by default and 200 at most, and a nextCursor: pass it as cursor for the next page, until it is null.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The report to act on, of any `type`, by its `id` from `listReports` or `createReport`. You can also copy it from the report's link in Rollstack (`appUrl`): it's the part right after `/slides/` or `/destinations/`.

query.description: Options for the call, such as filters, paging or how long to wait

cursor.description: Where to continue the list: pass the `nextCursor` returned with the previous page to get the next one. Omit it for the first page.

limit.description: Maximum number of runs to return on this page, from 1 to 200. Defaults to `20`.

name: listReportRuns
title: List report runs
